items.text: The contract preserves schema-first command/query/job/result envelopes, deny-bypass service boundaries, unit and provenance validation, protected/private-data controls, deterministic plugin declarations, current implemented-slice evidence, visible transport and permission-taxonomy TBDs, and the prohibition on compliance, certification, or professional-approval claims.

verification.text: Validate the contract and review source parity, operation-family and plugin-boundary coverage, current-versus-historical declarations, units/provenance/privacy and deny-bypass controls, diagnostic/result-envelope requirements, retained transport and permission TBDs, and professional-authority limits.
